struct TComm::Impl {
    bool              bSim;        // sim mode active (forced or fallback)
    bool              bSimForced;  // SetSimMode(true) requested explicitly
    bool              bOpen;       // between StartComm and StopComm

#if defined(_WIN32)
    HANDLE            hFile;       // real serial handle (INVALID when not open)
    HANDLE            hReader;     // reader thread handle (NULL when none)
    volatile LONG     bStopReader; // signal the reader to exit (0/1)
    TComm*            self;        // back-pointer for the thread proc
    //AI(W906-TORQUE-COMM) 20260925: 寫入佇列＋寫入執行緒（SPComm 的 TWriteThread）
    HANDLE            hWriter;     // writer thread handle (NULL when none)
    HANDLE            evTx;        // auto-reset: "queue has data" / "stop requested"
    volatile LONG     bStopWriter; // signal the writer to exit (0/1)
    CRITICAL_SECTION  csTx;        // guards txq
    std::deque<std::vector<char> > txq;  HANDLE evStop;  void* hCloser;   //AI(W906-COMM-STOPFAST) 20261006: evStop = manual-reset "stop" for the reader's idle wait (was Sleep(1) = one 15.6 ms timer tick); hCloser = the thread closing the last port handle (StopComm); same line
#endif

    std::vector<char> simTx;       // sim-mode captured tx bytes

    Impl()
        : bSim(false)
        , bSimForced(false)
        , bOpen(false)
#if defined(_WIN32)
        , hFile(INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
        , hReader(0)
        , bStopReader(0)
        , self(0)
        , hWriter(0)
        , evTx(0)
        , bStopWriter(0), evStop(0), hCloser(0)   //AI(W906-COMM-STOPFAST) 20261006: evStop / hCloser (same line)
#endif
    {
#if defined(_WIN32)
        ::InitializeCriticalSection(&csTx);  evStop = ::CreateEventA(0, TRUE, FALSE, 0);   //AI(W906-COMM-STOPFAST) 20261006 (same line)
#endif
    }
    ~Impl()
    {
#if defined(_WIN32)
        W906_CommJoinCloser(hCloser);  if (evStop != 0) ::CloseHandle(evStop);  ::DeleteCriticalSection(&csTx);   //AI(W906-COMM-STOPFAST) 20261006: the port is closed before the object goes; CloseHandle (same line)
#endif
    }
};
